snippet.title: Attack of the Jersey Drones | Patriotic Meta Quest & SteamVR Game!
snippet.description:
We’re excited to announce our latest game Attack of the Jersey Drones! It’s time to DEFEND YOUR FREEDOM! Launching this Friday on SteamVR and Meta Quest devices!

Wishlist it now!

Meta: https://www.meta.com/experiences/attack-of-the-jersey-drones/8822674001176336/
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3491650/Attack_of_the_Jersey_Drones/

Game Description:
ATTACK OF THE JERSEY DRONES is a short and simple Virtual Reality game about FREEDOM and PRIVACY!

As a retired war veteran, all you wanted was to live the rest of your days out in peace and quiet. Unfortunately for you, a swarm of drones (WHO COULD THEY POSSIBLY BE?) won't leave you alone. So there's only one thing to do. DEFEND. YOUR. FREEDOM!

- 15 to 30 minutes of pure patriotism!
- Shoot down an aggressive hoard of drones invading your neighborhood
- Unlock various classic American firearms (M1911, M16A1, UZI, M134 Minigun)
- Simple, easy-to-understand gameplay
- Roomscale experience. No need to worry about motion sickness!
